description: A chronic inflammatory scarring disorder of the scalp causing follicular pustules and progressive permanent hair loss.
causes: Chronic inflammatory follicular disorder; the precise initiating mechanism is not fully established

appearance.general: Pustules and crusting around scalp hairs with expanding areas of scarring hair loss.

warning_signs: Rapidly progressive permanent hair loss or painful inflamed scalp warrants dermatologic assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss the extent and progression of hair loss and whether scalp biopsy or fungal testing is needed.
